original_caption: Figure 14 and Fig. 15 show a pie chart and a map of the country distribution of UAV papers. In descending order, the top ten countries with the most drone papers since 2001 are United States of America, Switzerland, France, Australia, Germany, Japan, Spain, China, Italy, and South Korea. Other countries in the pie chart include Canada, Mexico, Venezuela, Brazil, United Kingdom, Portugal, Netherlands, Belgium, Aus- tria, Czech Republic, Croatia, Hungary, Slovakia, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Greece, Cyprus, South Africa, United Arab Emirates, Iran, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, India, Taiwan, Philippines, Malaysia, and Singapore. | REFERENCES
